monogr.title: Validation Data Using the FreshQA test part as a validation metric may lead to suspicion about the fairness of all the results. Therefore, we split an additional 20% of the training data as a validation and retrained two models. After retraining our classifier using only the training split of our dataset -further divided into training and validation sets for hyperparameter tuning -we achieved an F1 score of 0.845 for Small E5 and 0.836 for Large E5 on English data. As shown in Table 11, FreshQA scores remain close to the original results (Table 10), though the small model performs slightly worse
